name: com.pegproof/pegproof
description: Free stock token checks: address lookups across issuers, supply and events on Robinhood Chain

tools.name: check_address
tools.description: Check a contract address on Robinhood Chain before buying, holding or accepting it: a token in Robinhood's list, a known look-alike, or unknown. Free, and about identity only: for a listed token's supply, multiplier and integrity flags, use get_token_summary. A look-alike answer names the token it imitates; another issuer's listed token is unknown with issuer_list. For an address on Base, Ethereum or BNB Chain, use list_address_issuers. Same answer as GET https://pegproof.com/v1/address/{address}.

address.description: The contract address, 0x followed by 40 hex digits, either case.

tools.name: list_address_issuers
tools.description: List every issuer whose published token list includes an EVM address, one match per chain: Coinbase's tokenized stocks on Base, Robinhood's Stock Tokens on Robinhood Chain, Ondo Global Markets and xStocks on Ethereum and BNB Chain. Free. An address on no list gets the look-alike catalogue's answer, and chains_read says which chains' lists were read. For Robinhood Chain identity with look-alikes, use check_address. Same answer as GET https://pegproof.com/v1/lookup/{address}.

address.description: The contract address, 0x followed by 40 hex digits, either case.

tools.name: find_token
tools.description: Find the contract address of a stock token on Robinhood Chain by ticker or company name, before an agent buys it. Free. Use it when you have a name, not an address; to check an address you already have, use check_address. Returns Robinhood's tokens with the look-alikes pegproof knows of, then other issuers' listed tokens (pegproof does not check their supply). At most 10 matches: total counts them all and truncated says when the list was cut.

query.description: A ticker (NVDA) or a company name (Nvidia).

tools.name: get_token_summary
tools.description: Get a Robinhood stock token's current on-chain state: total supply, treasury balance, multiplier, ledger coverage, open integrity flags and the look-alikes pegproof knows of. Pass a ticker (NVDA) or a contract address on Robinhood Chain (4663); for a known look-alike address, the answer names the token it imitates. On-chain observations reconstructed from chain event logs, not financial advice. To only tell a listed contract from a look-alike, check_address answers that alone.

token.description: A ticker (NVDA) or a contract address (0x followed by 40 hex digits).

tools.name: list_token_events
tools.description: List the events that created or destroyed a Robinhood stock token's supply: every mint, burn, issue, redeem and transfer, newest first. Pass a ticker (NVDA) or a contract address on Robinhood Chain (4663); page through with the opaque cursor (keyset on block and log index). On-chain observations reconstructed from chain event logs, not financial advice. For the current totals use get_token_summary; for the totals at a past block, get_token_snapshot.

token.description: A ticker (NVDA) or a contract address (0x followed by 40 hex digits).

limit.description: Page size, 1-100 (default 20). Not refused when outside: above 100 is cut to 100, below 1 becomes 1, as on the HTTP routes.

cursor.description: The previous page's data.next_cursor; omit for the first page.

tools.name: list_incidents
tools.description: List integrity incidents across all of Robinhood's stock tokens, newest first: one call to monitor them all. An incident is a token whose supply or treasury balance diverged from its full mint/burn ledger, or a ledger rebaseline, with its type, status and block window. type=integrity (default), operational (collector errors) or all. On-chain observations and reconciliation findings, not financial advice. For one token's open integrity flags, use get_token_summary.

limit.description: Page size, 1-100 (default 20). Not refused when outside: above 100 is cut to 100, below 1 becomes 1, as on the HTTP routes.

tools.name: get_token_snapshot
tools.description: Get a Robinhood stock token's state at a past block: total supply, treasury balance and multiplier from the newest confirmed snapshot at or before it. Use it to check a historical position, report or trade against what was on-chain then. Pass a ticker or contract address and block=<number>. On-chain observations reconstructed from chain event logs, not financial advice. For the current state, use get_token_summary.

token.description: A ticker (NVDA) or a contract address (0x followed by 40 hex digits).

block.description: A Robinhood Chain block number; the newest snapshot at or before it is returned.
